user.title: Configure PC Boot Selector
user.description: Set up a new PC to manage its boot selection files.

os_entry.title: Add Boot Entry
os_entry.description:
Add an operating system option for this PC.

**How to retrieve this info:**
* **GRUB Entry ID**: Run `grep -E "submenu|menuentry" /boot/grub/grub.cfg` on client PC.
* **EFI Boot Number (BIOS)**: Run `efibootmgr` on client PC (e.g. `0002` for Boot0002).
* **Limine Config Block**: Run `blkid` for UUIDs.

**Limine Entry Config Example (Windows):**
```ini
protocol: efi_chainload
image_path: guid(2E39665E-E798-4C29-A9EF-A28E3F248290):/efi/Microsoft/Boot/bootmgfw.efi
```

instructions.title: Client Setup Instructions
instructions.description:
Your PC Boot Selector configuration files will be available publicly at:
* **Limine Config**: `{limine_url}`
* **GRUB Config**: `{grub_url}`
* **BIOS Config**: `{bios_url}`
* **OS Selection**: `{os_url}`

---

### 🖥️ Client Setup Instructions

Configure your client PC to load these remote configurations:

#### 1. Limine Setup
Add a script to fetch the Limine configuration:
```bash
wget -O /boot/limine.conf {limine_url}
```

#### 2. BIOS / UEFI Setup
Fetch `{bios_url}` and execute `efibootmgr -n "$BOOT_NEXT"` or `efibootmgr -o "$BOOT_ORDER"`.

#### 3. GRUB Setup
Source `{grub_http_url}` or download `{grub_url}`.
